# Voon IQ

> Voon IQ (Voon Oy) is a Finnish AI consulting and implementation company. We help companies in Finland adopt AI safely and quickly: AI opportunity mapping, process automation and agents, secure AI copilots, and data analytics. Typical first results within 30–60 days via a pilot. / Voon IQ on suomalainen tekoälykonsultointi- ja toteutusyritys: tekoälyautomaatio, tekoälyavustajat (copilotit), analytiikka ja tekoälykartoitus suomalaisille yrityksille.

Website: https://voon.fi (Finnish by default, English toggle on the page)
Contact: info@voon.fi
Business site: https://business.voon.fi/fi
Country served: Finland. Languages: Finnish, English.

## Services (Palvelut)

- AI opportunity mapping (AI-kartoitus ja mahdollisuuskartta): workflow review, value-vs-effort prioritisation, 30–60 day pilot plan.
- Process automation and agents (Prosessiautomaatio ja agentit): documents, email, tickets, CRM/ERP integrations, quality assurance and logging.
- Secure AI copilots (Tietoturvalliset AI-copilotit): company-specific assistant for search, summarisation, guidance and internal knowledge base with role-based access.
- Data & analytics (Data & analytiikka): forecasts, KPI dashboards, sales and churn analysis, demand forecasting, automated reporting.
- AI-readiness assessment (AI-ready yritystestaus): quick test of data, processes, skills, security and change readiness, with a 90-day priority list.
- Ongoing support and development (Jatkuva tuki ja kehitys): monthly improvements, security reviews, team training.

## Use cases (Käyttötapaukset)

- Sales: lead scoring, proposal drafts, customer notes and follow-ups.
- HR & recruiting: application pre-screening, competence profiles, interview guides — a human decides, AI assists.
- Customer service: reply drafts, guidance search, ticketing and quality control, also multilingual.
- Finance: invoice processing, anomaly detection and reporting.

## How we work (Miten etenemme)

1. Free initial mapping — identify the 2–3 best targets and agree goals.
2. Pilot — build an MVP, metrics and risk controls; show results with data.
3. Deployment — integrate into daily work, train teams, assure quality.
4. Scaling — extend working solutions and build the next automations.

## Packages and pricing (Paketit) — indicative, final quote depends on scope

- Start — from €990: quick discovery and an actionable plan.
- Pilot — from €3,900: one working solution built and its value measured.
- Scale — custom pricing: ongoing development across several use cases.

## FAQ

- Is this only for large companies? No. We start with pilots that also fit SMEs; the key is a clear use case.
- How is security handled? Permissions, boundaries and logging are always built in; we choose architectures where data stays under your control.
- How fast do results show? Often during the first pilot, typically within 30–60 days.
- Do we need a mature data platform? No. We start where you are: value first, then scale responsibly.
